title: VideoCaptureService
responsibility: Selects trusted video slots before recording and publishes bounded child references with original provenance.

inputs.name: VideoCaptureService.constructor.root
inputs.description: Original Git repository. Omission uses the current working directory, never the exported snapshot.

inputs.name: VideoCaptureService.constructor.services
inputs.description: Optional injected archive/reference/native collaborators. Omission creates the repository-owned production services.

inputs.name: VideoCaptureService.plan.input
inputs.description: Current source commit/tree, active owner, finite library and explicit slot selection. Reuse is proved before script import or browser creation.

inputs.name: VideoCaptureService.record.input
inputs.description: Current source and selected slots plus task-owned output directory and explicit browser factory/script loader. Those capabilities are needed only for stale slots.

inputs.name: VideoCaptureService.acknowledge.result
inputs.description: Retained capture result and private raw receipts to bind to the independently admitted attached parent before cleanup.

inputs.name: VideoCaptureService.acknowledge.record
inputs.description: SHA-256 record ID of the attached parent proving the exact submitted captures; an absent or untrusted parent never authorizes raw cleanup.

inputs.name: VideoCaptureService.acknowledgeDirectory.directory
inputs.description: Task-owned output directory containing the private receipt descriptor; the descriptor alone is not admission proof.

inputs.name: VideoCaptureService.acknowledgeDirectory.record
inputs.description: Attached verification parent ID that must independently prove the captures named by the directory receipt.

inputs.name: captureBatch.archive
inputs.description: Archive supplied to captureBatch under its declared NonNullable<VideoCaptureServices['archive']> contract.

inputs.name: captureBatch.protocol
inputs.description: Task-owned capture index and sidecar paths.

inputs.name: captureBatch.result
inputs.description: Capture lines, sealed child batches and private raw receipt bindings.

inputs.name: captureContext.input
inputs.description: Exact source, owner, finite video declaration and explicit selected slots for planning.

inputs.name: captureContext.root
inputs.description: Project checkout used for immutable source, evidence and tool reads.

inputs.name: convertedCapture.input
inputs.description: Exact source, owner, finite video declaration and explicit selected slots for planning.

inputs.name: convertedCapture.target
inputs.description: Slot-bound fixture and checkpoint context passed to the declared recording script.

inputs.name: convertedCapture.native
inputs.description: Timestamped native recording and its retained encoded media.

inputs.name: convertedCapture.context
inputs.description: Current operation context and its already established source bindings.

inputs.name: captureDigest.bytes
inputs.description: Retained bytes inspected against their declared type, size and integrity.

inputs.name: captureFile.path
inputs.description: Repository-relative source or evidence path used by this operation.

inputs.name: captureFile.sha256
inputs.description: Expected SHA-256 of the retained file bytes.

inputs.name: captureText.path
inputs.description: Repository-relative source or evidence path used by this operation.

inputs.name: captureText.maximum
inputs.description: Maximum metadata byte count admitted before parsing.

inputs.name: captureProtocol.directory
inputs.description: Task-owned directory containing the capture or retained receipt files.

inputs.name: captureReceipt.root
inputs.description: Project checkout used for immutable source, evidence and tool reads.

inputs.name: captureReceipt.result
inputs.description: Capture lines, sealed child batches and private raw receipt bindings.

inputs.name: captureReceipt.record
inputs.description: ID of the attached verification parent whose admitted captures prove the receipt.

inputs.name: captureReceipt.services
inputs.description: Caller-provided service adapters; omitted adapters use the standard implementation.

inputs.name: captureReceiptStore.directory
inputs.description: Task-owned directory containing the capture or retained receipt files.

inputs.name: captureResult.source
inputs.description: Exact source commit/tree and associated runtime identity.

inputs.name: captureResult.plan
inputs.description: Record/reuse selection after current-source and attached candidate proof.

inputs.name: captureResult.protocol
inputs.description: Task-owned capture index and sidecar paths.

inputs.name: captureRun.root
inputs.description: Project checkout used for immutable source, evidence and tool reads.

inputs.name: captureRun.options
inputs.description: Capture request plus task-owned output and explicit browser/script capabilities.

inputs.name: captureRun.plan
inputs.description: Record/reuse selection after current-source and attached candidate proof.

inputs.name: captureRun.context
inputs.type: { services: VideoCaptureServices; protocol: ReturnType<typeof captureProtocol>; result: VideoCaptureResult; }
inputs.description: Current operation context and its already established source bindings.

inputs.name: recordingAllowed.input
inputs.description: Exact source, owner, finite video declaration and explicit selected slots for planning.

inputs.name: captureScriptInput.plan
inputs.description: Record/reuse selection after current-source and attached candidate proof.

inputs.name: captureScriptInput.slot
inputs.description: Slot supplied to captureScriptInput under its declared VideoCaptureScriptInput['slot'] contract.

inputs.name: admittedScript.script
inputs.description: Declared recording hooks with callable reset, entry, record and exit behavior.

inputs.name: admittedScript.input
inputs.description: Slot-bound fixture and checkpoint context passed to the declared recording script.

inputs.name: admittedScript.plan
inputs.description: Record/reuse selection after current-source and attached candidate proof.

inputs.name: captureCheckpoint.script
inputs.description: Declared recording hooks with callable reset, entry, record and exit behavior.

inputs.name: captureCheckpoint.target
inputs.description: Selected clip and viewport with its exact declared script and fixture bindings.

inputs.name: captureCheckpoint.session
inputs.description: Task-owned native capture session for the selected viewport.

inputs.name: captureCheckpoint.boundary
inputs.description: Entry or exit checkpoint being observed.

inputs.name: captureSelection.input
inputs.description: Exact source, owner, finite video declaration and explicit selected slots for planning.

inputs.name: captureSelection.references
inputs.description: References supplied to captureSelection under its declared NonNullable<VideoCaptureServices['references']> contract.

inputs.name: captureSelection.root
inputs.description: Project checkout used for immutable source, evidence and tool reads.

inputs.name: sameSlot.left
inputs.description: First value used for the exact slot or identity comparison.

inputs.name: sameSlot.right
inputs.description: Second value used for the exact slot or identity comparison.

inputs.name: observedVideo.target
inputs.description: Slot-bound fixture and checkpoint context passed to the declared recording script.

inputs.name: observedVideo.native
inputs.description: Timestamped native recording and its retained encoded media.

inputs.name: observedVideo.signatures
inputs.description: Observed painted entry and exit checkpoint signatures.

inputs.name: observedVideo.stem
inputs.description: Task-owned basename for this capture and its poster.

inputs.name: validateVisits.target
inputs.description: Slot-bound fixture and checkpoint context passed to the declared recording script.

inputs.name: validateVisits.video
inputs.description: Video supplied to validateVisits under its declared VideoCapture contract.

inputs.name: validateVisits.duration
inputs.description: Actual retained duration bounding every admitted visit.

outputs.name: VideoCaptureService.run
outputs.description: The string result of VideoCaptureService.run.

outputs.name: VideoCaptureService.plan
outputs.description: Current-source record/reuse slot selection; reusable candidates retain their original capture provenance and still require admitted attached proof.

outputs.name: VideoCaptureService.record
outputs.description: Capture result with canonical lines, sealed child batches and private raw receipts. Raw attempts remain until an independently attached parent is acknowledged.

outputs.name: VideoCaptureService.acknowledge
outputs.description: Resolves only after the attached parent proves the exact result and raw receipts; only that admitted proof authorizes raw-cache cleanup.

outputs.name: VideoCaptureService.acknowledgeDirectory
outputs.description: Resolves after the directory receipt is revalidated against the attached parent; reading a local descriptor alone grants no cleanup authority.

outputs.name: captureBatch
outputs.description: The unknown result of captureBatch.

outputs.name: captureContext
outputs.description: The VideoCaptureEnvironment | undefined result of captureContext.

outputs.name: convertedCapture
outputs.description: The ConvertedCapture result of convertedCapture.

outputs.name: captureDigest
outputs.description: The string result of captureDigest.

outputs.name: captureFile
outputs.description: The Buffer result of captureFile.

outputs.name: captureText
outputs.description: The string result of captureText.

outputs.name: videoBatchSidecar
outputs.description: The unknown result of videoBatchSidecar.

outputs.name: captureProtocol
outputs.description: The unknown result of captureProtocol.

outputs.name: captureReceipt
outputs.description: The Promise<void> result of captureReceipt.

outputs.name: captureReceiptStore
outputs.description: The VideoCaptureResult result of captureReceiptStore.

outputs.name: captureResult
outputs.description: The VideoCaptureResult result of captureResult.

outputs.name: captureRun
outputs.description: The Promise<void> result of captureRun.

outputs.name: recordingAllowed
outputs.description: The void result of recordingAllowed.

outputs.name: captureScriptInput
outputs.description: The VideoCaptureScriptInput result of captureScriptInput.

outputs.name: admittedScript
outputs.description: The void result of admittedScript.

outputs.name: captureCheckpoint
outputs.description: The Promise<string | undefined> result of captureCheckpoint.

outputs.name: captureSelection
outputs.description: The Promise<VideoCapturePlan> result of captureSelection.

outputs.name: sameSlot
outputs.description: The boolean result of sameSlot.

outputs.name: observedVideo
outputs.description: The VideoCapture result of observedVideo.

outputs.name: validateVisits
outputs.description: The void result of validateVisits.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Source/context binding, recording authorization, explicit reviewer acknowledgements, observed checkpoints, visit admission, bounded media/metadata or attached raw cleanup receipt is invalid.

errors.name: adapter or callback rejection
errors.description: Git/LFS, bounded filesystem operations, native acquisition/encoding, or caller browser/script/diagnostics callbacks may reject; failed raw attempts remain available.
